set(SOURCE_FILES ${QT_RES}
    main.cpp
    model/Data.cpp
    view/Mainwindow.cpp
    view/sidebar/SideBar.cpp
    view/sidebar/CollapsibleElement.cpp
    view/control/Controlbar.cpp
    controller/Controller.cpp
    view/status/StatusBar.cpp
    controller/Worker.cpp
    view/chart/ChartView.cpp
    view/sidebar/PopupMessage.cpp
    view/sidebar/NumberInput.h
    view/AppStyle.h)

# Platform app icons, generated by packaging/generate-icons.sh
set(APP_RES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/res/app)
if(APPLE)
  list(APPEND SOURCE_FILES ${APP_RES}/IntegrationGui.icns)
  set_source_files_properties(${APP_RES}/IntegrationGui.icns
      PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)
elseif(WIN32)
  list(APPEND SOURCE_FILES ${APP_RES}/IntegrationGui.rc)
endif()

add_executable(IntegrationGui WIN32 MACOSX_BUNDLE ${SOURCE_FILES})

# macOS: Qt frameworks are bundled into IntegrationGui.app/Contents/Frameworks
set_target_properties(IntegrationGui PROPERTIES
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST ${APP_RES}/Info.plist.in
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE IntegrationGui.icns
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "Integration GUI"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "de.rwth.sdi.IntegrationGui"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING ${PROJECT_VERSION})
if(APPLE)
  set_target_properties(IntegrationGui PROPERTIES
      BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON
      INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../Frameworks")
endif()

target_compile_definitions(IntegrationGui PRIVATE PROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")

target_link_libraries(IntegrationGui PRIVATE
    integration_lib
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Widgets
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Charts
    Qt6::Svg)

install(TARGETS IntegrationGui
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
    BUNDLE DESTINATION .)
